symptom: `exec` of a pluggable widget from a bundled multi-widget `.mpk` fails "no definition for widget … (run 'mxcli widget init')" even after init (e.g. only AreaChart of Charts.mpk registers)
cause: `ParseMPK`/`getWidgetIDFromMPK` read only `WidgetFiles[0]`; a bundled `.mpk` (Charts) holds many widgets so only the first is registered/augmented
insight: Parse every widgetFile (`ParseMPKAll`); register all ids in `FindMPK`; augment the specific id (`ParseMPKWidget`); bump `WidgetDefGeneratorVersion` so existing projects regenerate. Issue #679. (Per-series datasource + chart CE0463 are separate, still open.)
